data.narrative:
Persona AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Nic Radford and Jerry Pratt that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader robotics and manufacturing sector comprising one public comparable (277810.KQ) and nine private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables—only one seed-stage peer was identified in the narrow universe—which precluded a reliable peer-median approach.

The analysis therefore relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $25M total raised proxy as a valuation baseline. This yields an implied valuation of $62M. Sensitivity testing around this multiplier produces a triangulated range of $53M (low), $62M (median), and $72M (high).

The valuation range of $53M–$72M is supported by one methodological pillar and carries material uncertainty regarding appropriate stage-transition multiples for the robotics and manufacturing sector specifically. Refining this analysis would require either identifying additional seed and early-growth stage comparables within the sector or benchmarking the 2.5x multiplier against observed early-stage progression within robotics more broadly. Key risks include market-dependent variance in stage multiples and company-specific differences in capital efficiency versus peer norms.
